artworks.title: Un philosophe
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of four men gathered around a table. Two men are at the center, one older with a balding head and the other with a fuller head of hair and a prominent nose. Both are depicted from the waist up. Behind them stands a bearded man with a stern expression and a hat. Another man is partially visible in the background. The table is bare except for a plate in front of the older man. The surroundings suggest a smoky atmosphere with amorphous cloud shapes overhead, possibly indicating a lively setting like a tavern or cafe.

artworks.title: Head of a Man, with Various Studies
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of The Old Print Shop)
artworks.description: The image shows a page filled with various sketch studies. There is a prominent sketch of a man shown from the shoulders up, positioned frontally, with defined facial features, including deep-set eyes and a prominent brow. The man wears a suit with a bow tie. Surrounding the main sketch are smaller, less detailed sketches: profiles of bearded men, several disembodied facial features like a nose and eyes, and silhouettes of faces in profile. There is also a sketch of a person from behind and a pig. The page is a light tan color.

artworks.title: Halte!!!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring exaggerated characters with large hats engaged in a dynamic interaction. The central character has exaggerated limbs and a long coat, holding both arms outstretched. Flanking the figure are large barrels on wheels, with characters peering out from behind each barrel. The exaggerated facial features and gestures add intensity and humor to the scene, and the bold use of lines and shading gives the drawing a lively, animated feel. The style suggests a satirical or caricature-like approach.

artworks.title: Study for "Stars and Dews and Dreams of Night"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Robert Halsband, 1962)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a full-length view of a person standing with their upper body slightly bent forward and looking to their left. The figure's head is turned to the side, revealing their facial features, including a prominent nose and a defined brow. The person's hair is styled back and appears to be in a loose, short ponytail. The individual is shown in an expressive pose with one arm crossing their body and the other resting near their abdomen. The background consists of plain brown paper, contrasting with the white highlights and black contours used to render the figure, emphasizing the form and musculature of the body. There are no visible details of jewelry or objects being held by the figure.

artworks.title: Louisa DuPonceau
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a side profile of a young person from the head to just below the shoulders. The person is facing the right side of the image, featuring a rounded face and a small, slightly upturned nose. Their hair is short and wavy, styled in soft curls. They wear a dress with a pleated, square neckline, wide shoulder straps, and a sash tied into a bow at the chest. A beaded necklace adorns their neck. The background is plain with a circular border, giving the image a classic portrait appearance.

artworks.title: Peter Stephen DuPonceau
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man's head-and-shoulders profile facing left. He has defined, classically handsome features, short curly hair, and is wearing a high-collared coat with a visible cravat or ascot. The background is a plain, light-toned surface, emphasizing the man in the central circle.

artworks.title: St. Christopher Carrying the Christ Child
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a large, bearded man standing upright with a child resting on his shoulder. The man holds a staff in one hand and is draped in a robe. The child has short, curly hair and is holding an orb with a cross on top. In the background, there is a building, trees, and another figure holding a lantern. The scene is intricately detailed in a monochromatic, woodcut style.

artworks.title: Independence Hall
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a historical building with a clock tower at the center. The tower has a spire and weathervane on top, and bare trees are on either side. The artwork features fine and detailed brushstrokes to depict the trees and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia and black. Some individuals are walking and talking near us, and in the distance, the building and trees create depth in the scene.

artworks.title: The Great Fall, Niagara
artworks.artist: Charles Risdon, after Frederick Edwin Church
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a print depicting the top of a large waterfall and the surrounding landscape. The top of the waterfall is the central focus, with water flowing towards the left, forming a curve around the central falls. The water close by is blue and green, with white foamy areas. Some gray-brown rocks can be seen below the moving water. A rainbow appears in the mist on the left, leading down towards the unseen bottom of the falls. The sky is filled with clouds in pale pink and gray hues, and the distant background shows trees with autumnal colors.

artworks.title: Joueur d'Orgue (Organ Grinder)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Marchal E. Landgren, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals interacting. On the left, an old man stands behind a wheeled organ grinder with both hands on the handles. He wears a dark jacket and a flat cap. The man shows his beard and mustache distinctly. Next to him is a woman who appears to be smiling with her mouth open. She leans slightly back, maintaining contact with the man's hand. Her long hair is pulled back, and she wears a long, dark dress. In the background, there is a building with shuttered windows and a sidewalk, providing a simple urban setting.

artworks.title: Franz Roh
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Brenda and Robert Edelson Collection, 1997)
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up view of a person's face, emphasizing the eyes, nose, and mouth, with no other body parts in view. The face fills the frame, with the eyes looking at the camera. The person wears thin-rimmed round glasses, and there are signs of aging around the eyes. The mouth is closed with slightly pursed lips. The image is in black and white, and the background is blurred, focusing solely on the facial features.

artworks.title: Ancien Hôtel des Parlementaires, 3 Rue des Lions
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Brenda and Robert Edelson Collection, 1998)
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a courtyard. The image shows a small courtyard with cobblestone paving. In the center, there is a decorative stone archway with baroque architectural detailing and a potted plant inside. On either side of the archway are doors, one of which is partially open. Above the courtyard, there are wrought-iron balconies attached to the building facade, with windows covered by curtains. Two wooden barrels are located on the ground. The structure has an aged elegance with textures of stone and iron indicating its historical character.

artworks.title: Sawley Abbey
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Murray Lebwohl, 1998)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon about a third of the way down from the top. The scene includes buildings, trees, a river, grazing cows, fields, and a sky with wispy clouds. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, capturing detailed scenery. The color palette is monochromatic with earthy tones of beige and brown.

artworks.title: Floraison du Cactus-grandiflorus...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals standing closely together, facing towards the center where a lit candle stands. Most individuals have exaggerated facial features and expressions of surprise or intrigue. They wear loose-fitting clothing typical of an earlier era, possibly the 19th century, and have a variety of hair styles. The scene appears to be indoors with a dimly lit background and a hazy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Retour d'une bonne action
artworks.medium: etching on cream china paper mounted on off-white wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Friends of the Corcoran Gallery of Art)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals positioned with one facing left and the other walking behind, both with dynamic postures as if encountering strong wind. The person in front has facial features obscured by a bonnet and wears a long dress. The other person wears a cap and a shorter dress. The person in front holds an umbrella turned inside out by the wind. The background displays a muddy path with puddles, sparse vegetation, buildings, and a cloudy sky with rain.

artworks.title: In the Land of Promise
artworks.artist: Frederick Juengling, after Charles Frederic Ulrich
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Friends of the Corcoran Gallery of Art)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded waiting area with various figures seated and standing around. The scene depicts a busy room filled with people engaged in activities such as conversing and sitting in attentive postures. In the foreground, a woman with a headscarf is seated with her hands crossed on her lap, next to a young girl seated on a crate at her feet. Bags and luggage are on the floor, suggesting travel. The figures wear hats and coats, indicating a cold environment. The composition is dense and bustling, showing a scene of an era where such gatherings were common in public waiting areas.

artworks.title: "-Ouriskoff!..trouvez-vous cela ressemblant?" from Actualities
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricatured military figure holding a portrait. The drawing depicts a man in elaborate military clothing, complete with a tall hat adorned with a plume. He is seated in profile, examining a sketch or portrait, while another figure dressed similarly stands to the side, also looking at the drawing. The background features a map labeled "Turquie" (Turkey). The style is humorous and satirical. The exaggerated facial features and clothing add to the comedic effect, making it a humorous reflection on identity and authority.

artworks.title: Ce monsieur Courbet...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image is a caricature drawing of a group of people from roughly the waist up. Three men in formal attire are at the center, standing close together. The man on the left has a serious expression and a top hat. The middle man has distinct features and an open mouth, as if speaking or singing, with a hat tilted to one side. The man on the right has sideburns and a mustache, looking upward with his mouth open. To the right of the men is a woman in profile wearing a bonnet. The background shows a crowd of people dressed similarly in a loose, overlapping style. The image is primarily monochromatic, with emphasis on line and shading for detail.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of curved lines and rounded shapes forming the silhouettes of two intertwined figures. The abstract portrayal suggests forms resembling entwined dancers or a dramatic embrace, with twisting bodies draped in cloth-like patterns. The figures evoke the familiarity of classic sculpture, connecting the viewer to the timeless imagery of ancient mythological or theatrical scenes.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image depicts curving lines and rounded shapes forming three interconnected figures. The figures suggest movement and flow. The shapes resemble dancers draped in swirling garments. The interconnected forms evoke a sense of unity and shared rhythm among the figures.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image features a figure standing upright with arms raised above their head, holding a large piece of billowing fabric. The figure's face and hair are not detailed. They are wearing draped, ancient-style clothing, with the fabric gathered at the waist. The background is a plain, neutral shade, highlighting the figure.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a dynamic pose with one arm raised, likely adjusting or holding their hair. The individual's face is in profile view, revealing soft facial features and long, flowing hair. They are draped in a long garment that billows outward, suggesting movement. The fabric appears soft and pliable, flowing around their form. The individual is barefoot and has no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is a plain, neutral-colored surface.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person viewed from behind, standing with their left arm raised and bent at the elbow, and their right arm extended downward. The person is wearing a headwrap and a long, flowing garment with a fabric or sash around their lower body. The background is a plain, neutral beige color.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in motion, captured mid-step with arms raised and legs apart. The person's facial features are not detailed, and they are wearing a cap and a loose garment that creates a sense of movement. The background is plain and light in color.
